what: Claude reads the sample fundraiser page (public/samples/fundraiser.html)

parsed_output.title: Help Maya get an accessible van (sample fundraiser)
parsed_output.beneficiary_description: Maya, 29, lives on her own and uses a power wheelchair. She is starting community college this spring, and the bus route does not reach campus. Organized by her mom, Rosa.

uses.description: Wheelchair ramp and lock-down conversion of a used minivan, done by Lakeside Mobility Conversions
First months of insurance on the van
Gas for her first semester of classes

explanation.plain: Maya's fundraiser is fully funded at $6,000! The money covers a wheelchair-accessible van conversion, insurance and gas so she can get to community college. Giftwise can help deliver it in a benefit-safe way.
explanation.technical: Goal $6,000; raised $6,000 from 48 donors. Stated uses: $5,200 ramp and lock-down conversion of a used minivan by Lakeside Mobility Conversions (equipment); $500 initial van insurance (transport); $300 gas for first semester (transport). Uses sum to $6,000. The page states Maya receives SSI, so mentions_benefits is true. Paying vendors directly (conversion shop, insurer) may help, since SSI generally counts cash and some in-kind support as income; benefit rules should be confirmed for her specific situation.
